summary: Three defects found: duplicate part label in Problem 4 (structural error), missing symbolic form in Problem 3 part е), and typo in figure alt text. The duplicate label creates ambiguity in problem structure.

defects.description:
Formula for E_dis is incomplete. The candidate provides 'E_{dis} = (-E_1) - h
u_{ion} = 2,73·10^-19 J = 1,70 eV' but the official solution shows the symbolic form 'E_{dis} = h
u_{dis} = (-E_1) - h
u_{ion}' to explicitly define E_dis as the photon energy h
u_{dis}.
Typo in alt text for figure p2-fig4: 'хактерни' (missing 'ар') should be 'характерни' (characteristic).
defects.suggestedFix: Траектория на неутрон, извършващ периодично движение с дъги над хоризонтална плоскост (неутронно огледало), характерни арки с еднаква височина.

defects.description: Problem 4 has two separate JSON entries both labeled 'б)' (parts at indices 1 and 2). According to the problems page, there is one б) part with two sub-questions: 'Колко е Γ?' [1.5 т] and 'Колко е оптичната сила Φ?' [1.0 т]. The duplicate label creates structural ambiguity and violates the requirement that each part have a unique label within a problem.
defects.suggestedFix: Merge the two 'б)' entries into a single part with both sub-statements, or label the second one with an appropriate sub-label (e.g., 'б)-i)' and 'б)-ii)') rather than duplicating 'б)'.
